findings.title: JWT Token Blocklist Not Enforced in Authentication Flow
findings.description: Token blocklist service exists but is never called. Tokens lack 'jti' claims and get_current_user() doesn't check blocklist.
findings.evidence: security.py lines 28-50: create_access_token() missing jti claim; deps.py lines 13-56: get_current_user() missing blocklist check; auth.py line 66: logout() doesn't blocklist token
findings.consequence: Logged-out users can continue using tokens until expiry. Compromised tokens cannot be revoked.
findings.correction: 1. Add jti claim (uuid) to create_access_token() and create_refresh_token(). 2. In get_current_user(), extract jti from payload and call token_blocklist_service.is_token_blocklisted(jti), raise 401 if blocklisted. 3. Update logout() to extract jti/exp from token and call blocklist_token().

findings.title: Crop Scanner Not Using Storage Service for Image Upload
findings.description: Crop scanner generates fake storage paths without actually uploading images via storage_service or image_service.
findings.evidence: Line 150: save_path = f"/uploads/crops/{random_name}" with no actual file write or storage_service.upload() call
findings.consequence: Images not validated (MIME, size), not stored in S3 when USE_S3=true, fake paths in database break retrieval, security risk from unvalidated uploads
findings.correction: After validation, call image_service.validate_image(file_bytes, filename). Replace line 150 with: save_path = await image_service.upload_image(file_bytes, filename, 'crops', user.id)

findings.title: Soil Test Image Upload Feature Not Implemented
findings.description: Model has report_image_path column and migration exists, but endpoint doesn't accept UploadFile parameter as required by plan Step 8.
findings.evidence: models/soil.py line 49: report_image_path column exists; endpoints/soil.py line 17: submit_soil_test() only accepts JSON, no File(...) parameter
findings.consequence: Users cannot upload lab report images despite UI expecting this feature
findings.correction: 1. Add 'file: Optional[UploadFile] = File(None)' parameter to submit_soil_test(). 2. In soil_service.create_soil_test(), if file provided, call image_service.upload_image(file_bytes, filename, 'soil', user.id) and store in report_image_path. 3. Add report_image_url to SoilTestResponse schema

findings.title: Rate Limiting Middleware Not Registered in Application
findings.description: Rate limiting middleware exists but is never added to FastAPI app. Plan Step 11 requires rate limits on login, forgot-password, and crop-scans.
findings.evidence: middleware/rate_limit.py defines limiter but main.py has no app.add_middleware(SlowAPIMiddleware) or app.state.limiter assignment
findings.consequence: No protection against brute force login attacks, no rate limiting on expensive crop scan operations, API vulnerable to abuse and DoS
findings.correction: 1. Import limiter in main.py. 2. Add app.state.limiter = limiter and exception handler. 3. Add @limiter.limit('10/hour') to /v1/auth/login and /v1/auth/forgot-password. 4. Add @limiter.limit('20/hour') to POST /v1/crop-scans

findings.title: Dashboard Caching Not Implemented
findings.description: Plan Step 14 requires dashboard summary cached with 5-minute TTL. Current implementation queries database on every request without Redis caching.
findings.evidence: endpoints/dashboard.py get_dashboard_summary() lines 24-124: no cache check or cache store calls, no cache invalidation
findings.consequence: Database hit on every dashboard load (high read load), slower response times for most-accessed endpoint, Redis caching not utilized
findings.correction: 1. Before database queries, check cache_service.get_json(f'dashboard:summary:{user.id}'). 2. After building response, call cache_service.set_json(cache_key, response.model_dump(), 300). 3. Add cache invalidation (cache_service.delete) in field and alert creation/update endpoints

findings.title: Weather Data Not Integrated in Dashboard Response
findings.description: Plan Step 17 requires dashboard summary to include weather data. Schema and endpoint missing weather field.
findings.evidence: schemas/dashboard.py line 45: DashboardSummaryResponse has no weather field; endpoints/dashboard.py line 120-124: response includes stats, fields, alerts but no weather
findings.consequence: Dashboard displays incomplete data; users cannot see weather advisory from backend
findings.correction: 1. Add WeatherCardSchema to schemas/dashboard.py with temperature, humidity, rain_probability, condition, advisory, last_updated. 2. Add weather: Optional[WeatherCardSchema] to DashboardSummaryResponse. 3. In get_dashboard_summary(), fetch weather for primary field's coordinates and include in response

findings.title: Environment Template Has Ambiguous Credential Placeholders
findings.description: Placeholder credential values could be mistaken for real values or committed accidentally.
findings.consequence: Risk of deploying with placeholder credentials or committing real credentials if .env.example copied without modification
findings.correction: Update placeholder values to be explicit: 'REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID', 'REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY', 'REPLACE_WITH_OPENWEATHERMAP_API_KEY'. Add comments with service URLs

findings.title: Integration Tests for Infrastructure Features Missing
findings.description: Plan Step 18 requires integration tests for storage, Redis, weather, and migrations. Required test files do not exist.
findings.evidence: Missing files: tests/test_storage.py, tests/test_redis.py, tests/test_weather.py, tests/test_migrations.py. Only test_auth_and_dashboard.py and test_all_features.py exist
findings.consequence: No verification that S3/Redis/weather work, cannot confirm 80% coverage requirement, no verification migrations are reversible
findings.correction: Create test files with minimum cases: test_storage.py (valid upload, invalid MIME, S3 vs filesystem); test_redis.py (cache, blocklist, invalidation); test_weather.py (mock mode, caching, API failure); test_migrations.py (upgrade, downgrade)
